reports.title: Weekend Tow Report #2
reports.subject: Footbrake 150 is on — Saturday is stacked
reports.preview: Gulfport's $25K weekend is underway. I-22, Swamp Bottom and No Problem all run Saturday. One Friday cancellation — Saturday is the day.

alert.label: FOOTBRAKE 150
alert.headline: TWIN $25K MAINS AT GULFPORT, NOV 13–15
alert.body: The 3rd Annual Forever Footbrake 150 is underway at Gulfport Dragway. Twin $25,000-to-win main events run Saturday and Sunday. Friday opened with Test n Tune ($25), a $3,000-to-win Gamblers Race, and an $8,000-to-win No Guts, No Glory race. Gate entry $150 per day. Spectators $15 per day, $40 weekend pass, kids 8 and under free. Pre-registration has closed. Sellout status is unverified.
bullets: Twin $25,000-to-win mains Saturday and Sunday ($2,000 runner-up, $750 semi-finalists, round money from round 4).
Friday: Test n Tune $25; $3,000 Gamblers Race; $8,000 No Guts, No Glory race.
Gate entry $150 per day. Spectators $15 per day, $40 weekend pass, kids 8 and under free.
Pre-registration closed. Sellout status unverified — do not claim it is sold out.

feature.title: The cold moved the weekend to Saturday
feature.body: Friday night racing at I-22 is off — temperatures dropping into the low 30s. Swamp Bottom moved its Saturday start earlier for the cold: gates 11 AM, track hot noon (was gates 2 PM). No Problem moved its start earlier too: gates 11 AM, track hot 1 PM (was gates 3 PM, track hot 4 PM). Saturday is the day: I-22 gates open 9 AM, Swamp Bottom 11 AM, No Problem 11 AM. At I-22 the forecast is mid-50s and sunny.
bullets: I-22 Friday Nov 13 cancelled for cold. Saturday only.
Swamp Bottom Saturday start moved earlier: gates 11 AM, track hot noon.
No Problem Saturday start moved earlier: gates 11 AM, track hot 1 PM.
Three tracks run Saturday: I-22 (9 AM), Swamp Bottom (11 AM), No Problem (11 AM).

questions: Swamp Bottom Bracket Bash, Nov 14–15: mentioned online, not confirmed with the track. Do not tow on that alone.
Street Car Takeover at No Problem, Nov 20–21: no official source yet. Dates and details unconfirmed.
Mobile International Dragway Put Up or Shut Up shootouts, Nov 14: a real flyer with real purses, but Mobile is not a GulfSouthDrags track yet — verify directly with the track before you tow.
Gulfport New Year's event: announced, no dates visible yet.
Byram Queens Way year-end finale: promoted, no date shown.

worth.title: Coming up: Gobble Wobble, Turkey Trot, Throwdown
worth.body: Montgomery Gobble Wobble Nov 19–22 (Thursday gates 8 AM, Test and Tune noon–8 PM, $50). Alabama Turkey Trot Nov 20–21 (Footbrake Saturday $5,000 to win; Pro Saturday $10,000 to win). Holiday Thanksgiving Throwdown Nov 21. Turkey Beach Bash Nov 27–29 at Gulfport — no pre-registration required just to race. Montgomery Thanksgiving Footbrake Challenge Nov 27–28 ($400 pre-entry rate ended Nov 13; now $500 at the gate ($250 single-day)). Last time out: Gulfport Nov 11, Michael Lewis won King of the Mountain (49 entries, $1,000 purse; 2026 series paid $23,960 total). Baileyton pit bikes Nov 11: Erek Hallmark won, Bailey Benda runner-up. Do not tow: Byram closed its 2026 season Nov 10; Twin City's season is over.
